discrepancy_root_cause_explanation: Prior reported Brier 0.0953 was an artifact of string pattern matching .str.contains(Wicket) on the match result text, which created a degenerate target with 11.6% positive base rate (Wicket-win phrasing). Re-evaluation on true match winner (win_team_id == batting_team_id, 47.6% base rate) produced Brier 0.3950 for the old weights. Correcting the target definition yields Brier 0.1386 for baseline Logistic Regression, and Brier 0.1356 for the CatBoost challenger.
